adrenal-crisis.primary_source: Society for Endocrinology adrenal crisis guidance

thyroid-storm.primary_source: ETA/BTA/Society for Endocrinology/Welsh Endocrine and Diabetes Society joint consensus on thyroid storm; ATA hyperthyroidism guideline for comparison
thyroid-storm.note: New 2026 joint consensus treatment text reviewed and incorporated into the v1.27 working package. Clinician release review and Portuguese product/hospital-protocol confirmation remain pending; do not present the draft as a locally adopted protocol.

myxedema-coma.primary_source: ETA/BTA/Society for Endocrinology/Welsh Endocrine and Diabetes Society joint consensus on myxoedema coma; ATA hypothyroidism guideline for comparison
myxedema-coma.stored_version: Joint consensus 2026 (ETJ-26-0044), focused regimen reconciliation; ATA 2014
myxedema-coma.note: 2026 joint consensus IV regimen remains concordant. Focused enteral review found the consensus supports transition to oral therapy after full consciousness but does not specify an acute oral/NG loading fallback when IV is unavailable. One retrospective single-centre series (n=14, mixed ages) reported oral loading/taper; not sufficient to adopt as a general adult emergency regimen. Local endocrine/pharmacy review remains required.

lower-gi-bleeding.primary_source: ESGE small-bowel capsule/DAE guideline 2022; ACG small-bowel bleeding 2015; ACG LGIB 2023; ESGE LGIB 2021
lower-gi-bleeding.stored_version: ACG small-bowel bleeding 2015; ESGE capsule/DAE update 2022; ACG LGIB 2023; ESGE LGIB 2021
lower-gi-bleeding.note: v1.32 focused small-bowel extension integrated into existing lower-gi-bleeding ID. ESGE 2022 supports capsule first-line and ideally within 48 h after overt bleeding, no routine second look, and device-assisted enteroscopy for capsule-positive lesions; ACG 2015 details unstable CTA/angiography and enterography in obstruction/negative capsule. Acute protocol crossovers are stated. Yellow pending human/local review; evidence base on some acute imaging branches includes older ACG guidance.

acute-mesenteric-ischemia.note: Focused anticoagulation review completed against ESVS 2025 and WSES 2022. Acute MVT: therapeutic UFH or LMWH first line; UFH practical when renal failure/urgent reversibility matters; ESVS recommends 3–6 months VKA/LMWH, DOAC alternative conditional, indefinite therapy for idiopathic/persistent risk. No universal acute UFH dose/nomogram is supplied by these guidelines; local weight-based protocol, monitoring, patient factors and human procedural review remain required. Other procedural recommendations are not exhaustively re-audited.

major-burns.primary_source: ABA Burn Shock Resuscitation guideline and burn referral guidance
major-burns.note: 2 mL/kg/%TBSA starting estimate applies to adults with at least 20% TBSA; titration and local burn-center protocol remain necessary.

smoke-inhalation-toxic-injury.primary_source: CDC carbon monoxide clinical guidance, EMA Cyanokit product information and ABA referral guidance
smoke-inhalation-toxic-injury.stored_version: Current online guidance and EMA label checked September 2026
smoke-inhalation-toxic-injury.note: CO/antidote instructions verified; airway and inhalation adjunct protocols vary. EMA source: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/cyanokit-epar-product-information_en.pdf

spontaneous-intracerebral-hemorrhage.primary_source: ESO/EANS guideline on spontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage plus AHA/ASA spontaneous ICH guideline
spontaneous-intracerebral-hemorrhage.note: BP, reversal, surgery, seizure and thromboprophylaxis boundaries cross-checked; prospective clinical validation remains pending.

acute-spinal-cord-compression.primary_source: NICE NG234 spinal metastases/MSCC plus 2024 acute traumatic spinal cord injury hemodynamic guideline
acute-spinal-cord-compression.note: Etiology-specific steroid and source-control gates preserved; traumatic MAP recommendation has very-low-certainty evidence.

cauda-equina-conus-emergency.primary_source: UK National Suspected Cauda Equina Syndrome Pathway
cauda-equina-conus-emergency.note: Emergency MRI timing, PVR limitation and non-delay referral rules cross-checked; prospective outcome validation remains pending.

pulmonary-embolism.primary_source: ESC/ERS acute pulmonary embolism guideline + ESC ACVC Clinical Decision-Making Toolkit
pulmonary-embolism.stored_version: ESC/ERS 2019 (formal guideline) + ACVC Toolkit 2025; v1.36 consolidation review 2026-10-02
pulmonary-embolism.note: Formal ESC guideline remains 2019; ACVC 2025 operational details reconciled. 2026 PRAGUE-26 catheter-directed thrombolysis is recorded as emerging evidence, not yet a replacement guideline. Remains yellow pending human PE/cardiology review and Portugal/Azores local reperfusion/anticoagulation protocol reconciliation.

arrhythmias-cardiac-arrest.note: Shared age-selection/safety router confirmed against ERC/RCUK 2025. Age-specific adult modules now include explicit 2025 energies, drug timing/doses and bradycardia escalation. Remains yellow pending human review and Portugal/Azores local operational reconciliation.

hypertensive-emergencies.primary_source: 2024 ESC Guidelines for elevated blood pressure and hypertension plus syndrome-specific stroke, aortic, ACS and pregnancy guidance
hypertensive-emergencies.note: Acute organ injury defines emergency. The general 20-25% first-hour MAP reduction must not be transferred to aortic, stroke or pregnancy syndromes.

acute-heart-failure.primary_source: ESC acute and chronic heart failure guideline and ESC acute cardiovascular care materials
acute-heart-failure.stored_version: ESC 2021 with current online review 2026; workflow v1.16
acute-heart-failure.note: Treatment is phenotype-based: congestion, blood pressure, perfusion and mechanical cause. Exact diuretic, vasodilator and inotrope dosing requires current protocol.

cardiogenic-shock.primary_source: ACC Expert Consensus Statement on Evaluation and Management of Cardiogenic Shock
cardiogenic-shock.note: Uses SCAI staging, serial perfusion assessment, rapid cause control and shock-team escalation. Vasoactive concentrations are pump-ready examples that still require local formulation and ceiling verification; temporary MCS is phenotype- and destination-dependent, not automatic.

acute-aortic-syndrome.primary_source: 2022 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Aortic Disease, checked against the existence of 2024 ESC PAAD guidance
acute-aortic-syndrome.stored_version: ACC/AHA 2022; external currency check 2026; workflow v1.18
acute-aortic-syndrome.note: Preserves anti-impulse sequencing, HR 60-80/min, SBP below 120 mm Hg or the lowest pressure maintaining perfusion, immediate type A surgery and urgent intervention for complicated type B disease.

cardiac-tamponade-pericardial-emergency.primary_source: 2025 ESC Guidelines for myocarditis and pericarditis plus current image-guided pericardiocentesis literature
cardiac-tamponade-pericardial-emergency.note: Definitive drainage is physiology- and cause-driven. The module distinguishes medical effusion from trauma, clot, postoperative collections, free-wall rupture and type A dissection, where surgical strategy or controlled bridge drainage may be required.

critical-valvular-disease.stored_version: ESC/EACTS 2021 with current online review 2026; workflow v1.16
critical-valvular-disease.note: Emergency stabilization differs by lesion; expert echocardiography and definitive structural intervention remain central.

airway-rsi.primary_source: Difficult Airway Society adult intubation guideline and SCCM rapid sequence intubation guideline
airway-rsi.note: Drug and weight-basis choices remain physiology- and formulary-dependent; continuous waveform capnography and post-intubation sedation are mandatory safety gates.

status-epilepticus.primary_source: NICE NG217 (updated 2025) + ACEP 2024 seizure clinical policy + AES convulsive status guidance/ESETT
status-epilepticus.stored_version: NICE NG217 updated Jan 2025; ACEP 2024; AES/ESETT dosing evidence; v1.36 review 2026-10-02
status-epilepticus.note: v1.36 adds explicit first-line benzodiazepine and second-line levetiracetam/fosphenytoin/valproate doses and refractory escalation. Remains yellow pending neurology/ICU review and Portugal/Azores formulary/EEG/escalation reconciliation.

pediatric-emergencies.primary_source: European Resuscitation Council pediatric life support
pediatric-emergencies.note: General pediatric assessment rules retained. Five age/syndrome-specific emergency modules were added in draft v1.33 and sourced individually; local pediatric medication/formulary and human release review remain pending.

iv-antihypertensive-selection.primary_source: 2024 ESC hypertension guideline plus syndrome-specific ACC/AHA, AHA/ASA and ACOG guidance and current product labels
iv-antihypertensive-selection.stored_version: ESC 2024; ACC/AHA aorta 2022; AHA/ASA ICH 2022; ACOG current bundle; DailyMed labels reviewed 2026
iv-antihypertensive-selection.note: Alternatives are syndrome-specific; clevidipine and labetalol concentrations were cross-checked against current product labels.

obstetric-emergencies.primary_source: ACOG Gestational Hypertension and Preeclampsia guidance and maternal emergency bundles
obstetric-emergencies.stored_version: ACOG Practice Bulletin 2020; current online review 2026
obstetric-emergencies.note: Urgent treatment of persistent severe hypertension and magnesium for eclampsia are safety anchors; exact drug regimens and delivery decisions require current local obstetric protocol.

anticoagulation-reversal.primary_source: ISTH SSC 2024 DOAC reversal guidance + agent product information + GI society guidance
anticoagulation-reversal.stored_version: ISTH SSC 2024; EMA andexanet product information; ACG-CAG 2022; ESGE 2026/2021; v1.36 review 2026-10-02
anticoagulation-reversal.note: v1.36 adds ISTH 2024 indications/non-indications, DOAC concentration thresholds, idarucizumab 5 g, andexanet low/high regimens and PCC positioning. Remains yellow pending hematology/pharmacy review and Portugal/Azores antidote/PCC formulary and emergency-release workflow verification.

empiric-antibiotics.primary_source: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026 + IDSA cUTI 2025 + current syndrome-specific IDSA/ESCMID guidance
empiric-antibiotics.stored_version: SSC 2026; IDSA complicated UTI 2025; v1.36 consolidation review 2026-10-02
empiric-antibiotics.note: v1.36 formalizes timing, MDR/anaerobe/antifungal stewardship, source-control and IDSA 2025 cUTI selection principles. No universal regimen table is stored. Remains yellow pending infectious-disease/pharmacy review and current Horta/Azores antibiogram/formulary validation.

toxicology.primary_source: Current poison-centre and agent-specific toxicology guidance
toxicology.note: Agent-specific antidote indications and doses require current poison-centre or authoritative verification.

medication-selection-safety.primary_source: Drug labeling, syndrome-specific guidelines and independently checked infusion arithmetic
medication-selection-safety.note: This is a safety workflow, not an independent formulary. Every high-risk drug remains syndrome-, patient- and protocol-specific.

upper-gi-bleeding.primary_source: ESGE peptic ulcer bleeding guideline 2026 and Baveno portal-hypertension consensus
upper-gi-bleeding.stored_version: ESGE peptic-ulcer guideline 2026; Baveno VII 2022; antithrombotic reconciliation 2026-09-28
upper-gi-bleeding.note: Focused upper-GI route and antithrombotic reconciliation completed in working draft v1.31. ESGE 2026 antithrombotic recommendations largely carried forward without re-evaluation; reversal/restart remain individualized. Yellow pending human and Portugal/Azores local protocol/formulary review.

trauma-major-hemorrhage.primary_source: European guideline on major bleeding and coagulopathy following trauma
trauma-major-hemorrhage.note: Early hemorrhage control, balanced resuscitation, warming, calcium surveillance and tranexamic acid within three hours are preserved; exact blood-pack ratios remain protocol-specific.

anaphylaxis.primary_source: Resuscitation Council UK emergency treatment of anaphylaxis guidance
anaphylaxis.note: IM adrenaline is first-line; age/weight dose, observation and refractory infusion protocols require current local verification.

aki-nephrology.note: Verify publication status of any new KDIGO AKI update before citing it as final.

soft-tissue-infections.primary_source: IDSA skin and soft tissue infection guidance

clinical-image-interpretation.primary_source: Modality-specific professional guidance plus independent local reference diagnosis
clinical-image-interpretation.stored_version: workflow v1.4; diagnostic performance not established
clinical-image-interpretation.note: Technical workflow only. Do not promote to green until representative de-identified cases are independently adjudicated and safety metrics are reviewed. Verify syndrome-specific guidance for management advice.

tension-pneumothorax.primary_source: Resuscitation Council UK 2025 guidance and BTS Pleural Disease/Procedures guidance 2023
tension-pneumothorax.note: Immediate decompression is physiology-led when tension is strongly suspected; technique and anatomical site remain context- and protocol-sensitive.

traumatic-intracranial-mass-effect.primary_source: Brain Trauma Foundation severe TBI 4th edition; Neurocritical Care Society cerebral edema guideline 2020; ENLS Pharmacotherapy Protocol 6.0; FDA nicardipine labeling
traumatic-intracranial-mass-effect.stored_version: BTF 2016 current online; NCS 2020; ENLS 6.0; FDA label 2022
traumatic-intracranial-mass-effect.note: BTF supports age-stratified SBP floors and CPP 60-70 mm Hg but not a universal upper BP target. NCS preference for HTS over mannitol in TBI is conditional with low-quality evidence; exact repeat dosing and sodium limits remain protocol-specific.

sodium-emergencies.primary_source: European Society of Endocrinology hyponatraemia guideline and Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance
sodium-emergencies.note: The 150 mL 3% bolus strategy remains current European guidance; individualize ceilings and relowering in high-risk patients. Hypernatremia assessment must include serum osmolar indices plus measured urine osmolality/electrolytes and ongoing losses.

potassium-emergencies.primary_source: UK Kidney Association Clinical Practice Guideline Management of Hyperkalaemia in Adults
potassium-emergencies.note: Calcium formulation and dose are setting-specific; insulin-glucose requires six-hour glucose surveillance and a hypoglycemia-prevention plan.

calcium-magnesium-emergencies.primary_source: Society for Endocrinology endocrine emergency guidance and current resuscitation guidance
calcium-magnesium-emergencies.note: Verify locally available calcium/magnesium formulation and infusion protocol before continuous replacement.

abdominal-aortic-aneurysm.primary_source: European Society for Vascular Surgery abdominal aorto-iliac aneurysm guideline
abdominal-aortic-aneurysm.note: Permissive hypotension, rapid vascular activation and definitive repair are central; POCUS confirms aneurysm but does not exclude rupture.

sedoanalgesia.primary_source: Royal College of Emergency Medicine Procedural Sedation in the Emergency Department
sedoanalgesia.note: Requires credentialed clinicians, continuous capnography, dedicated monitoring and immediate airway rescue capability.

diabetic-ketoacidosis-hhs.primary_source: ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults with Diabetes consensus report
diabetic-ketoacidosis-hhs.note: Uses revised adult DKA/HHS diagnostic and resolution criteria, potassium-first insulin safety, controlled HHS osmolality correction, beta-hydroxybutyrate monitoring and conditional prophylactic LMWH. Local fluid, potassium, insulin and renal/weight anticoagulant protocols still apply.

acid-base-emergencies.primary_source: Standard quantitative acid-base physiology plus syndrome-specific current guidance
acid-base-emergencies.note: Formulas are decision aids; sample type, albumin, clinical context and mixed disorders must be verified. Treatment recommendations require the relevant syndrome module.

blood-gas-image.primary_source: Clinical image workflow with independent value verification
blood-gas-image.stored_version: workflow v1.13; oxygenation calculations; diagnostic performance not established
blood-gas-image.note: No OCR accuracy claim. Every value, decimal and unit must be visually verified; unlabeled specimens cannot be treated as arterial. P/F and A-a gradient quantify impairment but do not alone establish ARDS.

acute-respiratory-failure.primary_source: ATS/ESICM/SCCM ARDS mechanical ventilation guidance plus syndrome-specific current guidance
acute-respiratory-failure.stored_version: ATS implementation guidance current online review 2026; workflow v1.13
acute-respiratory-failure.note: P/F severity must be interpreted with actual FiO2, respiratory support/PEEP, timing, imaging and edema origin; verify current local ventilatory and proning protocols.

acute-severe-asthma.primary_source: Global Initiative for Asthma strategy report
acute-severe-asthma.note: Adult emergency pathway uses controlled oxygen, repeated inhaled SABA, ipratropium for severe attacks, early systemic steroid and one-time IV magnesium when response is inadequate. Intubation and dynamic-hyperinflation management remain expert/local-protocol dependent.

copd-exacerbation.primary_source: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease report and pocket guide
copd-exacerbation.note: Preserves controlled oxygen, short-acting bronchodilators, prednisone-equivalent 40 mg for five days, conditional antibiotics and early bilevel NIV for hypercapnic acidosis. Antibiotic agent remains culture-, ecology- and patient-dependent.

life-threatening-hemoptysis.primary_source: Society of Chest Imaging and Interventions consensus guideline and CIRSE bronchial-artery embolisation standards
life-threatening-hemoptysis.note: Life threat is physiology-based rather than volume-only. Airway/lung isolation, CTA versus bronchoscopy order and definitive embolization or surgery depend on stability, source and local capability; tranexamic acid is adjunctive and must not delay source control.

oxygen-therapy-emergency.primary_source: British Thoracic Society emergency oxygen guidance; Resuscitation Council UK ABCDE and adult emergency handbook; device-specific NHS oxygen policies
oxygen-therapy-emergency.stored_version: BTS current online recommendations; RCUK current online review 2026; workflow v1.14
oxygen-therapy-emergency.note: Target saturation is primary. Low-flow FiO2 is approximate; Venturi settings must follow the exact device label because colours and source-flow requirements can vary by manufacturer.

high-flow-nasal-oxygen.primary_source: ERS clinical practice guideline for HFNC in acute respiratory failure; Roca multicenter ROX validation study
high-flow-nasal-oxygen.note: ROX cutoffs derive from adults with pneumonia and must be used as serial risk signals, not universal intubation thresholds. Clinical deterioration overrides ROX.

noninvasive-ventilation.primary_source: Official ERS/ATS NIV guideline; BTS/ICS acute hypercapnic respiratory failure guideline and NIV quality-improvement algorithm
noninvasive-ventilation.stored_version: ERS/ATS 2017; BTS/ICS 2016 with 2017 correction; workflow v1.15
noninvasive-ventilation.note: Core COPD and cardiogenic pulmonary edema indications remain supported, but exact settings, circuits, interfaces and escalation thresholds require local protocol and expert review.

acute-abdomen.primary_source: WSES syndrome-specific emergency-surgery guidance and ACR Appropriateness Criteria
acute-abdomen.note: This umbrella module requires diagnosis-specific imaging and surgical guidance.

acute-liver-failure.primary_source: AASLD acute liver failure position paper and current AASLD clinical education
acute-liver-failure.stored_version: AASLD position paper 2011; current online review 2026
acute-liver-failure.note: Early transplant-center discussion and immediate NAC for suspected acetaminophen toxicity are preserved; non-acetaminophen NAC is specialist/context dependent.

acute-musculoskeletal-pain.primary_source: ACP/AAFP acute musculoskeletal injury pain guideline plus diagnosis-specific emergency guidance

alcohol-withdrawal.primary_source: ASAM Clinical Practice Guideline on Alcohol Withdrawal Management
alcohol-withdrawal.note: Agent, cumulative dose and monitoring remain setting-, age- and liver-function dependent.

altered-consciousness.primary_source: ACR Appropriateness Criteria for altered mental status/coma/delirium plus syndrome-specific resuscitation guidance

chest-xray.primary_source: ACR Appropriateness Criteria and modality-specific radiographic quality standards
chest-xray.note: Image workflow guidance does not establish diagnostic accuracy.

cns-infection.primary_source: WHO guidelines on meningitis diagnosis, treatment and care plus encephalitis guidance
cns-infection.note: Empiric treatment must not be delayed by lumbar puncture or imaging when delay is unsafe.

ct-mri-screenshot.primary_source: ACR Appropriateness Criteria plus image-review safety workflow
ct-mri-screenshot.note: A screenshot or incomplete series cannot exclude whole-study pathology; diagnostic performance is not established.

delirium.primary_source: NICE delirium guideline and geriatric emergency-care guidance
delirium.stored_version: NICE CG103 with current surveillance; review 2026

dermatology-severe.primary_source: Diagnosis-specific dermatology guidance for SJS/TEN, DRESS and severe cutaneous infection

dvt.primary_source: ESVS venous thrombosis guideline and CHEST antithrombotic guidance

ecg-image.primary_source: AHA/ACC/ESC ECG standards plus image-review safety workflow
ecg-image.stored_version: workflow v1.17; diagnostic performance not established

ecg-pocus-integration.primary_source: ACEP ultrasound guidance plus syndrome-specific ECG guidance

electrolytes.primary_source: Child sodium, potassium and calcium-magnesium module evidence records

emergency-infectious-diseases.primary_source: WHO, CDC and IDSA syndrome-specific guidance

emergency-procedures.primary_source: Procedure-specific RCEM, ACEP, WHO and specialty guidance
emergency-procedures.note: Every invasive procedure requires a current local protocol, credentialing and rescue plan.

endocrine-metabolic.primary_source: Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance and diagnosis-specific consensus statements

ent-emergencies.primary_source: ENT UK and diagnosis-specific airway/foreign-body guidance

environmental-emergencies.primary_source: Wilderness Medical Society and ERC syndrome-specific environmental guidance

headache-sah.primary_source: AHA/ASA aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage guideline and ACEP acute headache policy
headache-sah.stored_version: AHA/ASA 2023; ACEP policy current online review 2026

hematology-oncology.primary_source: ASCO/ESMO and specialty syndrome-specific oncologic emergency guidance

infective-endocarditis.primary_source: ESC Guidelines for the management of endocarditis

musculoskeletal-xray.primary_source: ACR trauma Appropriateness Criteria and NICE fracture guidance
musculoskeletal-xray.note: Published figures used for workflow checks are excluded from accuracy metrics unless blinded and independently adjudicated.

non-coronary-chest-pain.primary_source: AHA/ACC chest-pain guidance plus ESC/ACR syndrome-specific guidance

observation-discharge.primary_source: ACEP clinical policies and diagnosis-specific discharge/safety-net standards

ophthalmology-emergencies.primary_source: American Academy of Ophthalmology Preferred Practice Patterns and emergency diagnosis-specific guidance

ophthalmology-image.primary_source: AAO Preferred Practice Patterns plus image-review safety workflow

orthopedic-emergencies.primary_source: NICE non-complex and complex fracture guidance plus specialty standards

other-clinical-image.primary_source: Clinical image-review safety workflow and syndrome-specific guidance
other-clinical-image.stored_version: workflow v1.17; diagnostic performance not established

pancreatitis.primary_source: American College of Gastroenterology guideline on acute pancreatitis

pocus.primary_source: ACEP Ultrasound Guidelines: Emergency, Point-of-Care, and Clinical Ultrasound Guidelines in Medicine
pocus.note: Guidance supports governance and focused use; it does not validate model interpretation of ultrasound images.

pocus-image.primary_source: ACEP ultrasound guidance plus image-review safety workflow
pocus-image.stored_version: ACEP 2023; workflow v1.17; diagnostic performance not established

psychiatric-emergencies.primary_source: NICE and ACEP diagnosis-specific behavioral emergency guidance

rhabdomyolysis.primary_source: AAST Critical Care Committee Clinical Consensus Document on Rhabdomyolysis

skin-wound-image.primary_source: Clinical image-review workflow plus diagnosis-specific wound/dermatology guidance
skin-wound-image.stored_version: workflow v1.17; diagnostic performance not established

suicide-risk.primary_source: NICE Self-harm: assessment, management and preventing recurrence
suicide-risk.note: Risk scales must not be used alone to predict suicide or decide discharge.

syncope-falls-frailty.primary_source: ESC syncope guideline plus ACEP geriatric emergency guidance
syncope-falls-frailty.note: Core initial evaluation remains current; source age warrants continued surveillance.

febrile-infant-0-90-days.primary_source: Canadian Paediatric Society ≤90-day febrile infant statement (updated 2026); AAP febrile infant CPG
febrile-infant-0-90-days.note: Focused term, well-appearing infant pathway; explicit exclusions and age bands 0–28, 29–60, 61–90 days. Prematurity/comorbidity/ill appearance require separate pathway; locally approved Portugal/Azores algorithm and empiric antimicrobial choices need review.

bronchiolitis.primary_source: NICE NG9 bronchiolitis (oxygen threshold update 2021); Canadian Paediatric Society bronchiolitis position statement
bronchiolitis.stored_version: NICE NG9 current online, threshold update 2021; CPS 2021
bronchiolitis.note: Supportive care and oxygen thresholds checked against NICE/CPS. Local oxygen escalation/high-flow/PICU thresholds vary; yellow pending human/local review.

croup.primary_source: Canadian Paediatric Society acute croup statement; Royal Children’s Hospital acute upper-airway obstruction CPG
croup.note: Focused steroid/epinephrine bridge and observation boundary; local concentration/formulation and airway escalation protocol must be verified.

pediatric-dehydration-shock.primary_source: NICE NG254 suspected sepsis under 16 (2025); NICE NG29 pediatric IV fluids; RCH dehydration/gastroenteritis CPG
pediatric-dehydration-shock.stored_version: NICE NG254 2025; NG29; RCH current online 2026
pediatric-dehydration-shock.note: Shock bolus is cautious 10 mL/kg with reassessment; maximum 250 mL per bolus in suspected sepsis per NG254. DKA, neonates, hemorrhage, burns, cardiac/renal disease need syndrome-specific fluid plans.

pediatric-status-epilepticus.primary_source: HSE National Clinical Guideline CDI/0277/1.0/2025; NICE NG217
pediatric-status-epilepticus.stored_version: HSE effective 2025-10-15, review due 2028-10-15; NICE NG217 2025 update
pediatric-status-epilepticus.note: Weight/age-based 1 month–18 year convulsive status pathway. HSE explicitly excludes neonates <1 month and breakthrough seizures in established epilepsy; use individualized/neonatal pathway. Local Portugal drug protocol/formulary and specialist review pending.

adult-arrhythmias.note: Focused v1.36 review against official ERC/RCUK 2025 completed; explicit operational doses/energies and pacing/drug timing added. Remains yellow pending human clinical review plus Portugal/Azores equipment, formulary and local protocol reconciliation.

adult-cardiac-arrest.note: Focused v1.36 review against official ERC/RCUK 2025 completed; explicit operational doses/energies and pacing/drug timing added. Remains yellow pending human clinical review plus Portugal/Azores equipment, formulary and local protocol reconciliation.

pediatric-arrhythmias.primary_source: European Resuscitation Council 2025 Paediatric Life Support; Resuscitation Council UK 2025 Paediatric Life Support
pediatric-arrhythmias.stored_version: ERC/RCUK Paediatric Life Support 2025; v1.36 focused consolidation review 2026-10-02
pediatric-arrhythmias.note: v1.36 focused review added explicit 2025 pediatric shock, arrhythmia and arrest operational details. Remains yellow pending human pediatric/critical-care review plus Portugal/Azores equipment, formulary, concentration and local protocol reconciliation.

pediatric-cardiac-arrest.primary_source: European Resuscitation Council 2025 Paediatric Life Support; Resuscitation Council UK 2025 Paediatric Life Support
pediatric-cardiac-arrest.stored_version: ERC/RCUK Paediatric Life Support 2025; v1.36 focused consolidation review 2026-10-02
pediatric-cardiac-arrest.note: v1.36 focused review added explicit 2025 pediatric shock, arrhythmia and arrest operational details. Remains yellow pending human pediatric/critical-care review plus Portugal/Azores equipment, formulary, concentration and local protocol reconciliation.

undifferentiated-shock.primary_source: ERC 2025 resuscitation guidance and cause-specific authoritative pathways indexed in router
undifferentiated-shock.stored_version: Focused shock phenotype and routing audit 2026-09-28
undifferentiated-shock.note: Etiology coverage mapped to existing indexed modules. Reassessment, fluid/vasopressor choices remain phenotype- and cause-specific; human/local review required.

pediatric-shock.primary_source: European Resuscitation Council 2025 Paediatric Life Support; Resuscitation Council UK 2025 Paediatric Life Support
pediatric-shock.stored_version: ERC/RCUK Paediatric Life Support 2025; v1.36 focused consolidation review 2026-10-02
pediatric-shock.note: v1.36 focused review added explicit 2025 pediatric shock, arrhythmia and arrest operational details. Remains yellow pending human pediatric/critical-care review plus Portugal/Azores equipment, formulary, concentration and local protocol reconciliation.

vasoactive-inotrope-infusions.primary_source: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026 (Crit Care Med 2026, doi:10.1097/CCM.0000000000007075); SSC 2021; US product labels (norepinephrine, Vasostrict, epinephrine, dopamine, dobutamine, milrinone, phenylephrine, Giapreza); EU/UK SmPC (noradrenaline, Simdax)
vasoactive-inotrope-infusions.stored_version: SSC adult 2026 + current product labels; v1.36 consolidation review 2026-10-02
vasoactive-inotrope-infusions.note: SSC 2026 adult vasopressor sequence reconfirmed. Vasopressin 0.01-0.07 U/min and 0.1/1 U/mL label concentrations reconfirmed. Norepinephrine base/salt wording hardened: use the exact product's declared norepinephrine-equivalent strength and never infer tartrate conversion. Remains yellow pending human ICU/pharmacy review and Portugal/Azores RCM/formulary/standard-concentration verification.

icu-sedation-analgesia-infusions.primary_source: SCCM PADIS 2018 (Crit Care Med 2018;46:e825-e873) and PADIS 2025 focused update (Crit Care Med 2025;53:e711-e727); EU/UK SmPC (Dexdor, remifentanil, midazolam, fentanyl, Ketalar); US Diprivan label; KSCCM 2021 PADIS opioid table
icu-sedation-analgesia-infusions.stored_version: SCCM PADIS 2018 + 2025 focused update + current product information; v1.36 consolidation review 2026-10-02
icu-sedation-analgesia-infusions.note: PADIS 2025 conditional preference for dexmedetomidine over propofol when light sedation and/or delirium reduction are highest priorities reconfirmed; 2018 preference for propofol/dexmedetomidine over benzodiazepines retained. Dexmedetomidine ICU no-loading and max 1.4 micrograms/kg/h product information reconfirmed. Remains yellow pending human ICU/pharmacy review and Portugal/Azores product/formulary reconciliation.
